prompts.impact: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite sheet for Army of One, painted WWII collectible miniature tabletop shooter viewed STRICTLY from directly overhead. Columns are six consecutive animation frames from left to right: tiny sharp initial contact, growing burst, peak, diminishing debris and dust, faint tail, almost completely transparent final wisps. Row 1: warm ochre dusty ground impact with small earth chips. Row 2: brighter steel ricochet golden-white needle sparks and a restrained grey puff. Row 3: variation of dusty stone impact with jagged small pale chips. Row 4: variation of steel ricochet with asymmetrical radial sparks. These are tiny bullet hits, not fireball explosions. Expansion is radial in the ground plane as seen straight down; no vertical plume, no side view. Hand-painted miniature VFX, clear chunky readable silhouettes, ivory sparks with warm amber accents and soft grey-brown dust, visually coherent temporal sequences. Maintain the exact same fixed grid and center in all cells. Output truly transparent background.
